text: [x]Reborn Deathrattle: Give all minions in your hand +1/+1.

abilities.span: Deathrattle: Give all minions in your hand +1/+1.

decisions.question: Does the Reborn copy keep the Deathrattle, so a second death gives another +1/+1?
alternatives: yes: Reborn returns the card with its text; each death triggers once
no: only the first death triggers
decisions.chosen: yes: Reborn returns the card with its text; each death triggers once
decisions.discriminating_case: Prototype dies, returns, dies again: minions in hand end +2/+2 rather than +1/+1 (REBORN_RULES_EVIDENCE E3: Deathrattles before Reborn, copy without enchantments)

decisions.question: Whose hand is 'your hand' when the minion dies under the opponent's control?
decisions.discriminating_case: an opponent takes control of the Prototype and it dies: their hand is buffed
